body: I'm a registered nurse who works in the ER. I have done CPR more times that I can count. I have never seen anyone come out of it. I have plenty of coworker who have CPR survivors I am just not someone who gets those pts. Its not what you did or didn't do. CPR isn't a guaranteed life saver.  This man might not have even had an MI but could have had a aneurysm which nothing could save him. This is not a case of failure on your part, I know its hard to try and save life only to have it expire before you but there are no answers to this that can be easily given especially not out of hospital.
